data.name: Kshiraj
data.gender_notes: Kshiraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Kshiraj is the king of milk ocean, who later became the God of rain and agriculture. He is also known as Indra, the God of thunder and rain. The name Kshiraj carries the meaning “King of Milk” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kshiraj usually hope their child will grow to embody king of milk and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kshiraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Milk.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kshiraj total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: In Indian society, Holi is celebrated as a festival of colors to mark the victory of Lord Vishnu over the demon king King Hiranyakashipu (who was also known as Holika).
data.spiritual_significance: Holi represents the victory of good over evil, the arrival of spring, and the start of new beginnings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kshiraj: The one who is the ocean of sacred cow's milk, symbolizing purity, nourishment, and abundance. The divine name evokes the essence of unconditional love, compassion, and the purest form of selfless service.

historical_references.reference: Kshiraj was a Yadava king, a kinsman of Krishna and the ruler of Mathura during the Mahabharata war. He was a powerful and just monarch who maintained peace and prosperity in his kingdom.
historical_references.context: Mahabharata war period in Indian history

historical_references.reference: Kshirasagar or Kshiraj was also the name of a 12th century Jain Tirthankara. He was the 22nd in the line of 24 Tirthankaras and is considered an embodiment of self-discipline and purity.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Kshiraj' is often associated with Ayurveda, an ancient Indian practice of holistic healing. In modern context, Kshiraj is commonly used as a username or handle for individuals or organizations promoting wellness, spirituality, and Ayurvedic practices on various social media platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.

name_in_real_life.story: Arjun Kshiraj, a teacher in Chennai, India, shares that their name Kshiraj meaning "King of Milk" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
